bull_argument.argument:
Rocket Lab reported record quarterly revenue of $234m, up 62%, and a $2.36bn backlog. These are tangible commercial milestones supporting an optimistic case that increased scale can eventually improve economics.

Losses, cash burn and roughly 67x snapshot sales make this a speculative execution thesis. A credible buyer must verify liquidity runway and profitable backlog conversion; the deep oversold downtrend is not proof of value, so any bullish case remains conditional on financial and operating milestones. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
Losses and negative USD321.81m snapshot FCF require funding runway analysis. Roughly 66.9x snapshot sales is period-dependent and still represents a substantial execution burden, not verified cheapness.

Oversold RSI follows a deep drawdown and a bearish moving-average stack; a single bounce from 61.53 does not establish a base. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
key_points: Losses and negative USD321.81m snapshot FCF require funding runway analysis.
Launch and systems execution, cash runway and dilution cannot be underwritten from equity alone.
Technical context: Oversold RSI follows a deep drawdown and a bearish moving-average stack; a single bounce from 61.53 does not establish a base.
bear_argument.rebuttal_to_previous: Orders and positive gross margins do not establish cash runway, profitable delivery or freedom from dilution; a deep share-price drawdown does not solve these.
